# www.pratibhadahal.com.np

> Prativa Dahal is a product designer in Kathmandu, Nepal, designing apps, websites and design systems with clear structure, motion and user-centred flows — and available for remote, on-site and hybrid work with international product teams.

Prativa Dahal designs digital products that solve real problems through clear systems and considered motion, creating work that feels simple to use and hard to forget. She is based in Kathmandu, Nepal and works remotely with clients worldwide, with product teams in the US, Europe and Asia. Her product design covers apps and platforms shaped around clear flows, solid structure and real user needs. Her digital experience design covers websites with considered layout, pacing and interaction. Her motion design covers interface animation and prototypes that show how a product moves and feels. Her design system work covers component libraries and design tokens built for consistency, speed and clean handoff.

## Featured case studies

- [Caremate](https://www.pratibhadahal.com.np/case-studies/caremate) — digital health platform: symptom understanding, vetted doctor booking, remote consults and emergency access
- [ProLeap](https://www.pratibhadahal.com.np/case-studies/proleap) — career platform combining learning, mentorship and workshops toward real career opportunities
- [Arkiva](https://www.pratibhadahal.com.np/case-studies/arkiva) — SaaS platform giving construction companies in Nepal a branded website and management dashboard
- [Aeva](https://www.pratibhadahal.com.np/case-studies/aeva) — lip gloss brand celebrating self-expression through color, shine and confidence
